mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher wages and consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between INDPRO and HOUST proxies indicates supply chain resilience; when both increase by 1%+ in a month, it signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in months with +1%+ INDPRO and HOUST growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS increases above $380,000 indicate strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS > $380,000, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in CPIAUCSL indicates easing inflation pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced interest rate hikes.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE proxies indicates labor market health; when PAYEMS increases by 0.5%+ and UNRATE decreases by 0.2%+ in a month, it signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in months with +0.5%+ PAYEMS and -0.2%+ UNRATE growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1%+ monthly increase in INDPRO during a 'late-cycle expansion' regime indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 55% of 'late-cycle expansion' instances with +1%+ INDPRO growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 18-month rolling window.
